root_cause_analysis: In setu/operators/lqp.py:load_parallel_pairs_phinc(), the column names for HuggingFace dataset 'LingoIITGN/PHINC' were hardcoded as 'Hinglish Code-Mixed Sentence' and 'Human Translated English Sentence' instead of the actual dataset schema columns 'Sentence' and 'English_Translation'. This raised a KeyError: 'Hinglish Code-Mixed Sentence' during train_operators.py. Prior to the hard-failure hardening, train_operators.py caught all exceptions and fell back to dummy synthetic pairs formed by repeating the exact same string 500 times. Fitting Ridge regression on rank-1 constant matrices caused the coefficient matrix W to shrink to ~0 (norm = 6.75e-9). At inference time, W_eff = (1 - alpha)*I + alpha*W collapsed to (1 - alpha)*I, which was normalized away by FAISS's L2 cosine normalization, rendering LQP a mathematical identity operator.
